---
title: "GC-MS/FID Report"
format:
  pdf:
    papersize: letter
    geometry: margin=0.6in
    fontsize: 9pt
params:
  result_rds: ""
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r setup}
library(knitr)
result <- readRDS(params$result_rds)
info <- result$info
t <- result$totals
q <- result$qc
```

## Total Compound Report

```{r header}
kable(
  data.frame(
    ` ` = c("Sample ID", "Sample Name", "Project Code", "Report Date", "Analyst"),
    `  ` = c(info$sample_id, info$sample_name, info$project_code,
             format(info$report_date, "%Y-%m-%d"), info$analyst),
    `   ` = c("Density", "Methanol", "Water", "GC Recovery", "Total:"),
    `    ` = c(sprintf("%.4f g/mL", info$density),
               sprintf("%.1f wt. %%", info$methanol_wt_pct),
               sprintf("%.1f wt. %%", info$water_wt_pct),
               sprintf("%.1f wt. %%", t$gc_recovery),
               sprintf("%.1f wt. %%", t$total)),
    `     ` = c("Aligned Peaks", "Unique Peaks", "Total Peaks",
                "Interpolated Peaks", "MS/FID Offset Time"),
    `      ` = c(q$aligned_peaks, q$unique_peaks, q$total_peaks,
                 q$interpolated_peaks, sprintf("%.3f min", q$ms_fid_offset)),
    check.names = FALSE
  ), 
  booktabs = TRUE, 
  align = "llllll"
)
```

```{r peaks}
# MS Match Score is an analyst-facing QC field and is omitted from the client PDF.
tbl <- fidms::total_compound_table(result)
tbl[["MS Match Score"]] <- NULL
kable(
  tbl, 
  booktabs = TRUE, 
  longtable = TRUE, 
  digits = 3,
  align = "llrlrrrl",
  digits = c(0,0,3,0,0,0,2,0),
  latex_options = "scale_down"
)
```

\newpage

## Summary Report

```{r summary-header}
kable(data.frame(
  ` ` = c("Sample ID", "Sample Name", "Project Code", "Report Date", "Analyst",
          "Density (g/mL)"),
  `  ` = c(info$sample_id, info$sample_name, info$project_code,
           format(info$report_date, "%Y-%m-%d"), info$analyst,
           sprintf("%.4f", info$density)),
  check.names = FALSE
), booktabs = TRUE)
```

::: {layout-ncol=2}

```{r families}
fam <- rbind(
  data.frame(`Compound Type` = result$families$compound_type,
             `Total Amount (wt. %)` = sprintf("%.1f", result$families$wt_pct),
             check.names = FALSE),
  data.frame(`Compound Type` = c("Methanol (external)", "Water", "TOTAL"),
             `Total Amount (wt. %)` = sprintf("%.1f", c(t$methanol, t$water, t$total)),
             check.names = FALSE)
)
kable(fam, booktabs = TRUE)
```

```{r elements}
el <- data.frame(
  Element = c(result$elements$element, "Sum"),
  `Calculated wt. %` = sprintf("%.2f", c(result$elements$wt_pct, t$element_sum)),
  check.names = FALSE
)
kable(el, booktabs = TRUE)
```

:::

**NOTE:** Elemental values are wt% sum of all GC determined compounds and does not include H~2~O

**NOTES:**

```{r notes, results='asis'}
cat(paste0(seq_along(fidms:::.summary_notes()), ". ", fidms:::.summary_notes()),
    sep = "\n\n")
```
